sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Pedro Rodríguez Filú, or Pedrínu as he came to be called, was born on June 17, 1954.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·罗德里格斯·菲卢（Pedro Rodríguez Filú），后来被称为“佩德里纽”（Pedrínu），出生于1954年6月17日。
zh_words: 佩德罗·罗德里格斯·菲卢

sentences.en: He had a misshapen skull due to a deliberate kick his mother, Manuela, had received to her pregnant belly from her husband, Pedro Rodríguez Sr.
sentences.zh: 他的头骨畸形，是因为他的父亲佩德罗·罗德里格斯老先生曾用力踢向怀孕的妻子曼努埃拉的腹部。

sentences.en: Given the level of violence their father inflicted upon their mother, Pedrínu and his seven younger siblings were lucky to be born at all.
sentences.zh: 考虑到父亲对母亲施加的暴力程度，佩德里纽和他的七个弟弟妹妹能平安降生已是万幸。

sentences.en: The Rodríguez children grew up on a farm in the Brazilian municipality of Santa Rita do
sentences.zh: 罗德里格斯家的孩子们在巴西圣丽塔杜苏布卡伊市的一个农场长大，

sentences.en: Subucaí, south of the state of Minas Gerais.
sentences.zh: 那里位于米纳斯吉拉斯州南部。

sentences.en: Although the family was poor, they did not experience the extreme poverty that afflicted
sentences.zh: 尽管家里很穷，但他们并没有经历20世纪50年代和60年代巴西农村地区普遍存在的那种极端贫困，

sentences.en: much of rural Brazil during the 1950s and 60s, at which time impoverished citizens were often viewed as disposable.
sentences.zh: 当时贫困的平民往往被视为可随意丢弃的草芥。

sentences.en: Crime was commonplace.
sentences.zh: 犯罪在当地司空见惯。

sentences.en: Clean water was mostly diverted for crops, and a lack of sanitation led to diseases for which there was no money to treat.
sentences.zh: 干净的水源大多被引去灌溉农作物，缺乏卫生设施导致了各种疾病，而他们根本没钱医治。

sentences.en: A common saying in the area was that God must exist, because the devil certainly did.
sentences.zh: 当地有句俗话：上帝一定存在，因为魔鬼确实存在。

sentences.en: Pedrínu Sr.
sentences.zh: 老佩德罗·罗德里格斯

sentences.en: worked hard for a meagre salary as a night security guard at a local school, and was considered an agreeable man until he drank alcohol, which brought out his violent temper.
sentences.zh: 在当地一所学校当夜间保安，薪水微薄，工作勤恳。在不喝酒时，他被认为是个随和的人，但酒精会激发出他暴戾的脾气。

sentences.en: Manuela was a religious disciplinarian who was quick to punish her children and unafraid to administer beatings.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉是一位信奉宗教的严母，她惩罚孩子时毫不手软，也从不畏惧体罚。

sentences.en: Her eldest, Pedrínu, would often accompany her to church, but he never understood what the pastor was saying and would sometimes fall asleep, earning him a thrashing.
sentences.zh: 长子佩德里纽常陪她去教堂，但他从听不懂牧师在讲什么，有时会睡着，这让他免不了一顿毒打。

sentences.en: Pedrínu's grandfather, Joachim, whom Pedrínu described as a simple gentleman, became his
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽的祖父若阿金（Joachim）被他形容为一位淳朴的绅士，成为了他的

sentences.en: mentor, teaching him skills he needed in order to survive, including how to swim, plant, harvest, hunt, and defend himself.
sentences.zh: 导师，教会了他生存所需的技能，包括游泳、种植、收割、狩猎和自卫。

sentences.en: Joachim took Pedrínu to his job at the butchery and taught him how to carve up an ox carcass, which served Pedrínu well when he later started work at a chicken slaughterhouse.
sentences.zh: 若阿金带佩德里纽去他的屠宰场工作，教他如何分割牛尸，这为佩德里纽后来在鸡肉屠宰场的工作打下了基础。

sentences.en: Joachim coached Pedrínu to become a, quote,
sentences.zh: 若阿金训练佩德里纽成为一个，引用他的话，

sentences.en: He grew into a tough teenager, and although he was smaller than most boys his age, he was determined and fearless.
sentences.zh: 他长成了一个强硬的少年，尽管比同龄人瘦小，但他意志坚定，无所畏惧。

sentences.en: Pedrínu's most defining characteristic was his deep resentment of injustice.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽最显著的特征就是他对不公有着极深的怨恨。

sentences.en: In 1967, Pedrínu was 13 years old and violence was a part of his daily life.
sentences.zh: 1967年，13岁的佩德里纽生活在暴力之中。

sentences.en: He saw it at home, in the streets, and at his work, where animals were slaughtered without any regard to humane practices.
sentences.zh: 他在家里、街上以及工作中都目睹了暴力，那里的动物被屠宰时完全不顾及人道。

sentences.en: On one occasion, he took his cousin's horse for a ride without asking and in return received a forceful punch to the face.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他未经允许骑了表哥的马，结果被对方狠狠地打了一拳。

sentences.en: Shocked, Pedrínu looked directly at his much older and larger cousin and said,
sentences.zh: 震惊之余，佩德里纽直视着比他年长且强壮的表哥，说道：

sentences.en: I'm going to kill you.
sentences.zh: “我要杀了你。”

sentences.en: His cousin laughed and hit him again.
sentences.zh: 表哥大笑起来，又打了他一下。

sentences.en: Other family members who heard about the altercation laughed at Pedrínu for being weak.
sentences.zh: 其他听到这件事的家人嘲笑佩德里纽软弱无能。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, he found himself consumed by feelings of revenge and injustice.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，他被复仇和不公的念头彻底吞噬。

sentences.en: Pedrínu's grandfather worked at the local sugarcane mill, and one day, Pedrínu and his cousin were assisting him.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽的祖父在当地的甘蔗磨坊工作，有一天，佩德里纽和表哥去帮忙。

sentences.en: The two were responsible for feeding the sugarcane through the press, a machine consisting of two rollers that crushed the brown juice out of the stalks.
sentences.zh: 两人负责将甘蔗送入压榨机，这台机器由两个滚轮组成，能将甘蔗中的棕色汁液挤压出来。

sentences.en: Pedrínu waited for the right moment before calmly shoving his cousin into the press, pushing him with all his might in an effort to force his body through the rollers.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽等待着时机，随后冷静地将表哥推向压榨机，用尽全力试图将他的身体塞进滚轮中。

sentences.en: His cousin's arm was mangled up to his shoulder, but the rest of his body jammed up against the machine.
sentences.zh: 表哥的手臂被绞烂直到肩膀，但身体的其他部分卡在了机器上。

sentences.en: Pedrínu tried pushing his cousin's head into the rollers, but it was the wrong size and shape, causing the rollers to spin against it without grabbing hold.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽试图把表哥的头塞进滚轮，但尺寸和形状不对，导致滚轮在上面空转，无法将其卷入。

sentences.en: Pedrínu then grabbed a pair of pruning shears and began stabbing his cousin, hoping to cut him up enough to force him through.
sentences.zh: 于是，佩德里纽抓起一把修枝剪开始捅刺表哥，希望把他切碎一点以便塞进去。

sentences.en: Workers overheard the screams and raised the alarm.
sentences.zh: 工人们听到了尖叫声并拉响了警报。

sentences.en: The boy's grandfather came to the rescue and turned the machine off.
sentences.zh: 男孩的祖父赶来救援，关掉了机器。

sentences.en: Pedrínu spent several nights in jail, but as his family depended on him, they informed the police that no charges would be laid.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽在监狱里待了几个晚上，但由于全家都依赖他，家人告诉警察不会起诉他。

sentences.en: As Pedrínu was a minor, the police agreed to let him go.
sentences.zh: 由于佩德里纽未成年，警方同意放人。

sentences.en: He was made to clean the blood and flesh off the sugarcane press as punishment, which took him four weeks to complete.
sentences.zh: 作为惩罚，他被要求清理甘蔗压榨机上的血肉，这花了他四周的时间才完成。

sentences.en: He felt no remorse for severely wounding his cousin, instead telling the tale with amusement, saying it gave him pleasure and he had righted an injustice.
sentences.zh: 他对自己重伤表哥毫无悔意，反而津津乐道地讲述这件事，说这让他感到愉悦，并且他纠正了一桩不公。

sentences.en: A year later, Pedrínu Sr.
sentences.zh: 一年后，老佩德罗

sentences.en: was accused of stealing food and stationery from the school where he worked during his nightly patrols.
sentences.zh: 被指控在夜间巡逻时从工作的学校偷窃食物和文具。

sentences.en: He blamed the daytime guard for the crimes, but was fired with no severance pay and branded a thief, making it impossible for him to get another job as a security guard.
sentences.zh: 他指责白天的保安才是罪魁祸首，但还是被解雇了，没有遣散费，还被贴上了小偷的标签，这让他再也无法找到保安的工作。

sentences.en: Unemployed, he was unable to provide for his family and they had to get by on the money
sentences.zh: 失业后，他无法养家糊口，一家人只能靠

sentences.en: Manuela made as a cleaner and laundress.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉做清洁工和洗衣工挣来的钱勉强度日。

sentences.en: Pedrínu took to the jungle with his grandfather's rifle, hunting monkeys to sell for their pelts, which would be turned into fine leather.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽带着祖父的步枪躲进丛林，猎杀猴子并出售它们的皮毛，这些皮毛会被制成高级皮革。

sentences.en: Things only worsened for his family and Manuela often broke down in tears.
sentences.zh: 家里的情况每况愈下，曼努埃拉经常伤心落泪。

sentences.en: Pedrínu sincerely believed the school's daytime guard was responsible for the theft and that those in a position of power refused to listen to his father's side of the story.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽坚信学校白天的保安才是盗窃案的元凶，而那些掌权者拒绝听取他父亲的辩解。

sentences.en: The headmistress and the deputy mayor who had the power to hire and fire the school guards took the word of the daytime guard without analysing the evidence.
sentences.zh: 有权雇佣和解雇学校保安的女校长和副市长，在没有调查证据的情况下，轻信了白天保安的一面之词。

sentences.en: Pedrínu packed his grandfather's .36-caliber rifle, ammunition, a machete and a tent into a green army backpack and went camping in the mountains for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽把祖父的.36口径步枪、弹药、一把大砍刀和一个帐篷装进一个绿色军用背包，去山里露营了30天。

sentences.en: He only hunted what was necessary to survive, cautious not to exploit the woods or mistreat the wildlife.
sentences.zh: 他只猎杀生存必需的动物，小心翼翼地不去破坏森林或虐待野生动物。

sentences.en: He later explained in his autobiography, Pedrínu Matador.
sentences.zh: 他后来在自传《杀手佩德里纽》中解释道：

sentences.en: I didn't go there to live or to hide from my probleMs.
sentences.zh: “我不是去那里生活或躲避问题的。”

sentences.en: When I got the guns, I had a plan and I already knew what I was going to do.
sentences.zh: “当我拿到枪时，我已经有了计划，也知道自己要做什么。”

sentences.en: I was going to get revenge.
sentences.zh: “我要复仇。”

sentences.en: He returned to civilisation and one night lay in wait outside the deputy mayor's house, watching as a jeep rolled up the drive.
sentences.zh: 他回到文明社会，一天晚上埋伏在副市长家外，看着一辆吉普车驶入车道。

sentences.en: The deputy mayor emerged from the vehicle and turned in surprise at the sound of a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 副市长从车里出来，听到枪声后惊恐地转过身。

sentences.en: Pedrínu fired again, killing the mayor instantly before fleeing the scene.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽再次开枪，当场击毙了副市长，随后逃离现场。

sentences.en: Although the murder gave him a feeling of righteousness, he still seethed over his father's unfair treatment.
sentences.zh: 尽管这次谋杀让他感到一种正义感，但他对父亲遭受的不公待遇依然愤愤不平。

sentences.en: A month later, Pedrínu went to the school and waited in the storeroom where the daytime guard started his day.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，佩德里纽来到学校，在白天保安开始工作的储藏室里守候。

sentences.en: When his target arrived, Pedrínu pointed the rifle at him and ordered him to sit in a chair in the middle of the room.
sentences.zh: 当目标出现时，佩德里纽用枪指着他，命令他坐在房间中央的椅子上。

sentences.en: He looked the guard in the eye and asked,
sentences.zh: 他盯着保安的眼睛问道：

sentences.en: Did you see what you did?
sentences.zh: “你看到你做的好事了吗？”

sentences.en: It destroyed my family.
sentences.zh: “它毁了我的家庭。”

sentences.en: My brothers are starving because of you.
sentences.zh: “我的兄弟们因为你而挨饿。”

sentences.en: Is it fair that you did this?
sentences.zh: “你这样做公平吗？”

sentences.en: Realising who he was, the guard began to sob, apologise and beg for his life.
sentences.zh: 意识到对方是谁后，保安开始啜泣、道歉并乞求饶命。

sentences.en: Pedrínu shot him twice, then covered his body with furniture and boxes.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽连开两枪，然后用家具和箱子盖住尸体。

sentences.en: He set the pile on fire and fled.
sentences.zh: 他点燃了那堆杂物，然后逃走。

sentences.en: He took refuge at his godmother's house in metropolitan Sao Paulo, where he met a local woman known as Booty.
sentences.zh: 他在圣保罗大都会区的教母家避难，在那里遇到了一个当地女人，人称“战利品”（Booty）。

sentences.en: The widow of a well-known drug trafficker, Booty was a gangster who used her beauty and influence to attract adolescents and children to her criminal organisation.
sentences.zh: 作为一名知名毒枭的遗孀，“战利品”是一个黑帮分子，她利用自己的美貌和影响力吸引青少年和儿童加入她的犯罪组织。

sentences.en: She welcomed Pedrínu into her home, where she engaged him in sexual activity, despite the fact that he was only 14, and put him to work trafficking and dealing drugs.
sentences.zh: 她收留了佩德里纽，尽管他只有14岁，她还是让他参与性行为，并让他从事毒品贩运和交易。

sentences.en: Although he had little experience, Pedrínu's relationship with Booty enabled him to take
sentences.zh: 虽然经验不足，但佩德里纽与“战利品”的关系使他能够

sentences.en: on a higher position within the criminal hierarchy, but older and more experienced dealers were jealous and unwilling to recognise his authority.
sentences.zh: 在犯罪等级中占据更高的位置，但那些年长且经验丰富的毒贩对此心生嫉妒，不愿承认他的权威。

sentences.en: The girlfriend of one of his rivals warned him to watch his back and be prepared for an ambush when he least expected it.
sentences.zh: 其中一名竞争对手的女友警告他要小心背后，提防在他最意想不到的时候遭到伏击。

sentences.en: Shortly after, some of the other boys invited Pedrínu to a local lagoon to escape the heat and smoke cannabis.
sentences.zh: 不久后，其他几个男孩邀请佩德里纽去当地的一个泻湖避暑并吸食大麻。

sentences.en: As he walked down the incline toward the water, he noticed his companions were armed and acting strangely.
sentences.zh: 当他沿着斜坡走向水边时，他注意到同伴们都带着武器，举止怪异。

sentences.en: He'd pulled out a gun and ordered them to drop their weapons, demanding to know why they were planning to kill him, but they turned and fled.
sentences.zh: 他掏出枪命令他们放下武器，质问他们为什么要杀他，但他们转身逃跑了。

sentences.en: Pedrínu shot at them, killing two and severely injuring another.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽向他们开枪，打死两人，重伤一人。

sentences.en: He came to be known as Pedrínu Cartouchera, or Cartridge Petey, due to his weapon of choice, a two-shot, 12-gauge sawn-off pipe shotgun.
sentences.zh: 他开始被称为“佩德里纽·卡图切拉”（Pedrínu Cartouchera），即“弹药佩德里纽”，因为他惯用的武器是一把双管12号截短猎枪。

sentences.en: Pedrínu worked with two friends whom he trusted.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽与两个他信任的朋友一起行动。

sentences.en: The trio watched out for each other, taking it in turns to stand guard while the other two slept.
sentences.zh: 三人互相照应，轮流站岗，让另外两人睡觉。

sentences.en: Together they carried out numerous crimes, including one in Jacareí, an industrial town located between the cities of Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
sentences.zh: 他们一起犯下了多起罪行，包括在圣保罗和里约热内卢之间的工业城镇雅卡雷伊犯下的一起案件。

sentences.en: They were supposed to collaborate with a drug dealer who went by the name China, but Pedrínu
sentences.zh: 他们本应与一个绰号“中国”（China）的毒贩合作，但佩德里纽

sentences.en: took an immediate dislike to him, deeming him a bully and a cheat, and decided to rob him instead.
sentences.zh: 对他非常反感，认为他是个恶霸和骗子，于是决定抢劫他。

sentences.en: The trio stole China's drugs and guns, shooting one of his men in the process and injuring China and his brother.
sentences.zh: 三人偷走了“中国”的毒品和枪支，过程中开枪打死他的一名手下，并打伤了“中国”和他的兄弟。

sentences.en: Pedrínu then sold the items to a dealer he respected.
sentences.zh: 随后，佩德里纽把这些赃物卖给了一位他尊重的毒贩。

sentences.en: He soon found himself the prime target of Brazil's notorious death squads, which were vigilante
sentences.zh: 他很快发现自己成了巴西臭名昭著的“死亡小队”的首要目标，这些小队是

sentences.en: groups comprised of off-duty police officers and other members of the state security forces.
sentences.zh: 由休班警察和其他国家安全部队成员组成的治安组织。

sentences.en: They roamed the streets with the aim of ridding the slums of crime, killing drug dealers, vagrants
sentences.zh: 他们在街上游荡，旨在清除贫民窟的犯罪，杀害毒贩、流浪汉

sentences.en: and street children, with covert approval from the military government and invariably without consequence.
sentences.zh: 和街头流浪儿，并得到军政府的暗中许可，且往往无需承担任何后果。

sentences.en: In an effort to hide from both the death squads and his enemies, Pedrínu became transient, sleeping in cars, cemeteries and churches.
sentences.zh: 为了躲避死亡小队和敌人的追杀，佩德里纽居无定所，睡在汽车、墓地和教堂里。

sentences.en: He attended a drug transaction with his boss, Booty, but the meeting was ambushed by police after they were tipped off by rival dealers.
sentences.zh: 他与老板“战利品”一起参加了一次毒品交易，但由于竞争对手的告密，会议遭到了警察的伏击。

sentences.en: A shootout ensued and Booty was killed.
sentences.zh: 随后爆发了枪战，“战利品”被杀。

sentences.en: Sixteen-year-old Pedrínu was seriously injured but managed to escape, taking refuge with extended family.
sentences.zh: 16岁的佩德里纽受了重伤，但设法逃脱，并投靠了远房亲戚。

sentences.en: They introduced him to Condomblei Macumba, a religion considered by some to be witchcraft or black magic.
sentences.zh: 他们向他介绍了“康东布雷·马昆巴”（Condomblei Macumba），这是一种被某些人视为巫术或黑魔法的宗教。

sentences.en: A core belief of the practice is that good and evil are irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 该教派的核心信仰之一是善恶无关紧要。

sentences.en: Worshippers are taught to fully embrace and accomplish their life purpose, but are reminded
sentences.zh: 信徒被教导要充分拥抱并实现他们的人生目标，但被提醒

sentences.en: that any harm inflicted on another person will come back to the person who caused the injury.
sentences.zh: 任何对他人造成的伤害最终都会报应在施害者自己身上。

sentences.en: Rituals included offerings, ceremonial dancing and animal sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 仪式包括祭祀、仪式舞蹈和动物献祭。

sentences.en: Blood is used in many of the rituals as it is believed to represent life's pure essence and is considered the most sacred and symbolic substance.
sentences.zh: 血液在许多仪式中被使用，因为它被认为代表了生命的纯粹本质，是最神圣和象征性的物质。

sentences.en: Pedrínu willingly joined the religion and his hair and eyebrows were shaved as part of his indoctrination.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽自愿加入了该宗教，作为入教仪式的一部分，他的头发和眉毛被剃光。

sentences.en: His initiation ceremony took place in a deserted quarry at midnight, overseen by a dozen believers who danced to drumbeats.
sentences.zh: 他的入教仪式在午夜的一个废弃采石场举行，由十几名随着鼓点跳舞的信徒监督。

sentences.en: He was required to kill a cat and drink its blood before placing its entrails all over his body.
sentences.zh: 他必须杀死一只猫并喝下它的血，然后将猫的内脏涂满全身。

sentences.en: The carcass was then filled with seeds and buried.
sentences.zh: 猫的尸体随后被填入种子并埋葬。

sentences.en: Pedrínu believed the ritual had possessed him with powers of invincibility.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽相信这个仪式赋予了他无敌的力量。

sentences.en: He returned to the side a week later to dig up the cat's body and remove the seeds within, which had since hardened into beads.
sentences.zh: 一周后，他回到现场挖出猫的尸体，取出里面的种子，这些种子已经硬化成了珠子。

sentences.en: His uncle threaded them into a necklace and placed it around Pedrínu's neck, warning him to never take it off.
sentences.zh: 他的叔叔将它们串成项链戴在佩德里纽的脖子上，警告他永远不要摘下来。

sentences.en: In his autobiography, Pedrínu wrote,
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽在自传中写道：

sentences.en: From then on, the cops opened fire, but the bullets didn't hit me.
sentences.zh: “从那时起，警察开枪，但子弹打不中我。”

sentences.en: The enemies attacked and I defended myself with ease.
sentences.zh: “敌人进攻，我轻松自卫。”

sentences.en: Nothing would stop me.
sentences.zh: “没有什么能阻止我。”

sentences.en: Before, I was afraid.
sentences.zh: “以前，我很害怕。”

sentences.en: But after the ceremony, it was as if nothing could affect me.
sentences.zh: “但仪式之后，就好像没有什么能伤害我了。”

sentences.en: From that moment on, Pedrínu saw himself as a defender of the weak and vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，佩德里纽将自己视为弱势群体的捍卫者。

sentences.en: He hijacked food trucks to feed residents of slums, burned shops if he believed the owners had cheated customers, and killed men who harmed women.
sentences.zh: 他劫持运粮车来救济贫民窟的居民，烧毁他认为欺诈顾客的商店，并杀害伤害女性的男人。

sentences.en: His penalty for cruelty to animals was to inflict the same acts on the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 他惩罚虐待动物者的手段，就是对施害者施加同样的暴行。

sentences.en: He stole from drug dealers he deemed bad and sold their product to others he considered righteous.
sentences.zh: 他从他认为邪恶的毒贩那里偷窃，并将他们的产品卖给其他人，他认为这才是正义的。

sentences.en: He moved to Campo Grande, a neighbourhood in the west of Rio de Janeiro, where he fell in love with a girl named Maria Haparacita Olympia.
sentences.zh: 他搬到了里约热内卢西部的坎波格兰德社区，在那里爱上了一个名叫玛丽亚·哈帕拉西塔·奥林匹亚的女孩。

sentences.en: Maria soon became pregnant and the young couple moved into a modest shack.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚很快怀孕了，这对年轻夫妇搬进了一个简陋的小屋。

sentences.en: Pedrínu continued his vigilantism, regarding it as legally wrong, but morally juSt.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽继续他的治安行动，认为这在法律上是错误的，但在道德上是正当的。

sentences.en: When Maria was seven months pregnant, Pedrínu arrived home to find that she had been murdered, along with their unborn child and the man appointed to protect them.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚怀孕七个月时，佩德里纽回到家，发现她和他们未出生的孩子，以及被指派保护他们的人都被谋杀了。

sentences.en: The killers had used Maria's blood to scrawl the words, we will get you, on the wall.
sentences.zh: 凶手用玛丽亚的血在墙上写下了“我们要抓到你”的字样。

sentences.en: By this point, Pedrínu had so many enemies that he couldn't immediately conclude who was responsible,
sentences.zh: 此时，佩德里纽的敌人多到让他无法立即断定是谁干的，

sentences.en: and spent more than a year trying to find out, sometimes torturing informants for information.
sentences.zh: 他花了一年多的时间试图查明真相，有时甚至通过折磨线人来获取信息。

sentences.en: His enquiries went nowhere, until he stopped at a bar one day and was told a young woman from the
sentences.zh: 他的调查毫无进展，直到有一天他在一家酒吧停下，被告知一个来自

sentences.en: Paraíba Valley who drove a jeep was looking for him.
sentences.zh: 帕拉伊巴谷、开着吉普车的年轻女子在找他。

sentences.en: Pedrínu discovered she was the ex-wife of China, the drug dealer he had encountered and confronted two years prior.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽发现她是“中国”的前妻，也就是他两年前遇到并对抗过的那个毒贩。

sentences.en: She showed the scars, bruises and burn marks China had inflicted across her body, and revealed that it was him who ordered Maria's murder.
sentences.zh: 她展示了“中国”在她身上留下的伤疤、淤青和烧伤痕迹，并透露正是他下令谋杀了玛丽亚。

sentences.en: Pedrínu was frustrated that he hadn't suspected China sooner, given their hostile history.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽很懊恼，考虑到他们之间敌对的历史，他竟然没有早点怀疑“中国”。

sentences.en: He found out that China's brother was getting married the following Saturday, and recruited two friends to go with him, ordering that every man in attendance be shot.
sentences.zh: 他打听到“中国”的兄弟下周六要结婚，于是招募了两个朋友随行，并下令射杀所有出席的男性。

sentences.en: He warned that no women or children were to be harmed, stating, if you shoot them, you are going to have to deal with me.
sentences.zh: 他警告说不得伤害妇女或儿童，并称：“如果你开枪打他们，你就得面对我。”

sentences.en: The wedding celebrations were in full swing when Pedrínu and his friends snuck in, pretending to be invited guests and knocked on the door to the reception hall.
sentences.zh: 婚礼庆典正进行得如火如荼，佩德里纽和朋友们潜入进去，假装是受邀宾客，敲响了宴会厅的大门。

sentences.en: An older man answered, and Pedrínu told him,
sentences.zh: 一位老人开了门，佩德里纽告诉他：

sentences.en: I am an honoured guest of China, I believe, the most awaited guest of the night.
sentences.zh: “我是‘中国’尊贵的客人，我想，也是今晚最受期待的客人。”

sentences.en: Pedrínu and his cohorts burst into the venue, ordering all women and children upstairs.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽和同伙冲进会场，命令所有妇女和儿童上楼。

sentences.en: China came at Pedrínu with a revolver, but Pedrínu shot him in the chest with his trademark
sentences.zh: “中国”拿着左轮手枪冲向佩德里纽，但佩德里纽用他标志性的

sentences.en: 12-gauge shotgun, killing him instantly.
sentences.zh: 12号猎枪击中了他的胸部，当场将其击毙。

sentences.en: They continued shooting indiscriminately, stopping when their ammunition ran low, and then calmly walked through the carnage and to the bar for a drink.
sentences.zh: 他们继续无差别射击，直到弹药耗尽，然后冷静地穿过血泊，走到吧台喝了一杯酒。

sentences.en: In total, seven men had been killed and 16 others were injured.
sentences.zh: 总共有七名男子被杀，另有16人受伤。

sentences.en: The only woman hurt was China's mother, whose arm had been wounded in an attempt to protect her son.
sentences.zh: 唯一受伤的女性是“中国”的母亲，她在试图保护儿子时手臂受伤。

sentences.en: Pedrínu would later claim that the injury was her own fault.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽后来声称，那是她咎由自取。

sentences.en: News of the wedding massacre spread, earning 18-year-old Pedrínu the nickname Pedrínu Matador, which translated to Little Pete the Killer, or Killer Petey.
sentences.zh: 婚礼大屠杀的消息传开，18岁的佩德里纽获得了“佩德里纽·马塔多”（Pedrínu Matador）的绰号，意为“小佩特杀手”或“杀手佩特”。

sentences.en: His unbridled and merciless obsession with retribution made him a fearful figure, but some commended him for his reputation as a protector of women and children.
sentences.zh: 他那种肆无忌惮、冷酷无情的报复执念使他成为了一个令人恐惧的人物，但也有人因为他保护妇女儿童的名声而称赞他。

sentences.en: Pedrínu adopted the lifestyle of a cashed-up gangster and initiated a polyamorous relationship with twin sisters.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽（Pedrínu）过着挥金如土的黑帮生活，并与一对双胞胎姐妹开始了多角恋关系。

sentences.en: He reveled in his notoriety and the fear his presence had among those he considered scum, saying, I had money, morals, respect, and power.
sentences.zh: 他沉浸在自己的恶名和那些被他视为人渣的人对他产生的恐惧中，他说：“我有钱、有道德、有尊重、有权力。”

sentences.en: He worked to make sure criminals were more afraid of him than they were of the death squads.
sentences.zh: 他努力确保罪犯对他比对行刑队更感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Adding to the plethora of body art he'd already accumulated, he tattooed the words, I kill for pleasure, on the inside of his right forearm.
sentences.zh: 为了增加他身上已经积累的大量纹身，他在右前臂内侧纹上了“我为快乐而杀人”的字样。

sentences.en: On his left arm, he tattooed Maria's name and the inscription,
sentences.zh: 在他的左臂上，他纹上了玛丽亚（Maria）的名字和铭文，

sentences.en: I can kill for love.
sentences.zh: “我可以为爱而杀人。”

sentences.en: He would later tell journalist Roberto Cabrini on television news program Connects Our Reporter that he killed every day during this period.
sentences.zh: 后来他在电视新闻节目《连接我们的记者》（Connects Our Reporter）中告诉记者罗伯托·卡布里尼（Roberto Cabrini），在那段时期他每天都在杀人。

sentences.en: If a day went by without killing someone, he became agitated.
sentences.zh: 如果有一天没有杀人，他就会变得焦躁不安。

sentences.en: He told the reporter,
sentences.zh: 他告诉记者，

sentences.en: He drank the blood of his victims, believing it made him stronger.
sentences.zh: 他喝受害者的血，相信这能让他变得更强壮。

sentences.en: Brazilian law enforcement embarked on a manhunt to track Pedrínu down.
sentences.zh: 巴西执法部门展开了搜捕行动，试图追踪佩德里纽。

sentences.en: As a result, several of his trusted associates and friends were killed, causing his paranoia to grow.
sentences.zh: 结果，他几名心腹和朋友被杀，导致他的偏执感日益加重。

sentences.en: He trusted no one and constantly felt as though police were closing in on him.
sentences.zh: 他不信任任何人，总觉得警察正在逼近他。

sentences.en: On May 24, 1973, Pedrínu was having a drink at a bar where the father of his twin girlfriends worked.
sentences.zh: 1973年5月24日，佩德里纽正在一家酒吧喝酒，那是他双胞胎女友父亲工作的地方。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to him, the twins' father had alerted police of his presence and they soon stormed the building.
sentences.zh: 他不知道的是，双胞胎的父亲已经向警方举报了他的行踪，警察很快包围了这栋建筑。

sentences.en: Pedrínu was wounded in the subsequent gunfight.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽在随后的枪战中受伤。

sentences.en: Before he lost consciousness, he heard the officers screaming for his death.
sentences.zh: 在失去知觉前，他听到警官们大喊着要他死。

sentences.en: He awoke chained to a hospital bed, surrounded by nurses, police and reporters, to witness the moment Killer Pedrínu was formally charged with murder.
sentences.zh: 他醒来时被锁在医院的病床上，周围是护士、警察和记者，见证了“杀手佩德里纽”被正式指控谋杀的那一刻。

sentences.en: He spent 25 days recovering in the hospital, completely restrained and under 24-hour guard.
sentences.zh: 他在医院里度过了25天的康复期，全程被束缚并有24小时看守。

sentences.en: When he was well enough to be transferred to prison, he was provided with the option of going into protective custody or general population,
sentences.zh: 当他身体状况好转可以被转移到监狱时，他被给予了选择：进入保护性拘留还是普通监区，

sentences.en: where the friends, brothers and sons of many of his victims were serving sentences.
sentences.zh: 那里关押着他许多受害者的朋友、兄弟和儿子。

sentences.en: Pedrínu chose to go into the general population.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽选择了进入普通监区。

sentences.en: He basked in his newfound celebrity, but was disappointed upon learning he would only be charged with 18 homicides, telling the court, only that, it cannot be that little.
sentences.zh: 他沉浸在自己新获得的“名声”中，但得知自己只会被指控18起杀人案时感到失望，他告诉法庭：“只有这些？不可能只有这么少。”

sentences.en: Pedrínu insisted he had killed more than 100 men, but was convicted of only 14 murders and given a sentence of 126 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽坚称他杀死了100多人，但最终仅被判14起谋杀罪，刑期为126年。

sentences.en: When transferring Pedrínu to the jailhouse, officers put him in the back of the police wagon with a serial rapiSt.
sentences.zh: 在将佩德里纽押往监狱时，警官把他和一名连环强奸犯关在警车的后座里。

sentences.en: By the time they reached their destination,
sentences.zh: 当他们到达目的地时，

sentences.en: Killer Pedrínu had claimed another life.
sentences.zh: 杀手佩德里纽已经夺走了另一条生命。

sentences.en: Brazilian prisons are notorious for being some of the toughest and most violent in the world.
sentences.zh: 巴西的监狱以世界上最艰苦、最暴力而闻名。

sentences.en: In the early 1970s, conditions were particularly overcrowded, unsanitary, unsafe and inhumane, with infectious diseases such as tuberculosis and dengue fever spreading easily.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代初，监狱条件极其拥挤、肮脏、不安全且不人道，肺结核和登革热等传染病极易传播。

sentences.en: The average life expectancy for a prisoner was low and it was almost unheard of for an inmate to survive in jail for 15 years without dying of disease or at the hands of an enemy.
sentences.zh: 囚犯的平均预期寿命很低，几乎闻所未闻有囚犯能在监狱里活过15年而不死于疾病或敌手之手。

sentences.en: A Raracuara prison in Sao Paulo, where Pedrínu would be serving his time, was one of the roughest, with brutal bashings occurring daily and deaths almost as frequent.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽服刑的圣保罗拉拉夸拉（Raracuara）监狱是最残酷的监狱之一，每天都会发生残酷的殴打，死亡事件也几乎同样频繁。

sentences.en: Dozens of prisoners were sometimes held in a single small cell where there was not even enough room to lie down.
sentences.zh: 有时几十名囚犯被关在一个狭小的牢房里，甚至连躺下的空间都没有。

sentences.en: Prison guards were considered insensitive, crude and indifferent.
sentences.zh: 狱警被认为是麻木不仁、粗鲁且冷漠的。

sentences.en: The worst of them were sadistic or corrupt and willing to accept a bribe to break rules.
sentences.zh: 其中最坏的狱警是虐待狂或腐败分子，愿意接受贿赂来破坏规则。

sentences.en: The underpaid and outnumbered staff largely left prisoners to their own devices.
sentences.zh: 薪水微薄且人数处于劣势的工作人员基本上对囚犯采取放任自流的态度。

sentences.en: Guards would hand over the keys to internal locks to whichever inmates were running the show, with their own job confined to securing the outside of the prison.
sentences.zh: 狱警会将内部锁的钥匙交给那些掌控局面的囚犯，而他们自己的工作仅限于守卫监狱外围。

sentences.en: Weapons, drugs and even women were smuggled in on occasion.
sentences.zh: 武器、毒品甚至女性有时会被偷运进来。

sentences.en: For most inmates, the only way to stay safe was to join a gang that provided protection.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数囚犯来说，保持安全的唯一方法就是加入一个提供保护的帮派。

sentences.en: Gang warfare pitted criminals from different cities against each other and the resulting battles would often end in prisoners being decapitated
sentences.zh: 帮派战争让来自不同城市的罪犯相互对抗，由此引发的战斗往往以囚犯被斩首告终，

sentences.en: or disemboweled in displays of power.
sentences.zh: 或者被剖腹以展示权力。

sentences.en: Pedrínu entered prison young even by Brazilian standards, where half of all male prisoners were aged between 20 and 29.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽入狱时年纪尚轻，即使以巴西的标准来看也是如此，那里一半的男性囚犯年龄在20到29岁之间。

sentences.en: Even though the grim reputation of regional prisons was well known, he was completely unprepared for what awaited him.
sentences.zh: 尽管地区监狱的恶名众所周知，但他对等待着他的一切完全没有准备。

sentences.en: In his autobiography, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 他在自传中写道，

sentences.en: By the time I went through processing,
sentences.zh: 当我走完入狱流程时，

sentences.en: I began to understand what I would go through.
sentences.zh: 我开始明白我将要经历什么。

sentences.en: The cell was small.
sentences.zh: 牢房很小。

sentences.en: There was no mattress.
sentences.zh: 没有床垫。

sentences.en: There was nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: Just the frozen concrete floor.
sentences.zh: 只有冰冷的水泥地。

sentences.en: There was no shower.
sentences.zh: 没有淋浴。

sentences.en: It was just a water nozzle.
sentences.zh: 只有一个水龙头。

sentences.en: There was no toilet.
sentences.zh: 没有厕所。

sentences.en: There was only a hole in the floor.
sentences.zh: 地板上只有一个洞。

sentences.en: As the newest arrival,
sentences.zh: 作为新来的，

sentences.en: Pedrínu's sleeping area was closest to the toilet hole.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽的睡觉区域离厕所洞最近。

sentences.en: From the moment he arrived, his crimes, reputation and notoriety made him the target of other prisoners.
sentences.zh: 从他到达的那一刻起，他的罪行、名声和恶名就使他成为了其他囚犯的目标。

sentences.en: With the help of a cellmate,
sentences.zh: 在一名狱友的帮助下，

sentences.en: Pedrínu fashioned a knife by sharpening a spoon into a point that he carried with him at all times.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽把一把勺子磨尖做成了一把刀，他随身携带。

sentences.en: When he first entered the prison yard, five men surrounded him while other inmates silently watched on.
sentences.zh: 当他第一次进入监狱操场时，五个人包围了他，而其他囚犯则在旁边默默注视。

sentences.en: Reports differ over what happened next, but three of the men who ambushed Pedrínu were killed and the remaining two were badly wounded.
sentences.zh: 关于接下来发生的事情，报道各不相同，但伏击佩德里纽的三人被杀，其余两人受重伤。

sentences.en: It quickly became known that Pedrínu would kill without hesitation.
sentences.zh: 很快大家都知道，佩德里纽杀人从不犹豫。

sentences.en: When he wasn't using makeshift shivs or illegally obtained weapons, he relied on his bare hands to break fellow prisoners' necks.
sentences.zh: 当他不使用自制的尖刀或非法获得的武器时，他会用赤手空拳折断狱友的脖子。

sentences.en: He taught himself martial arts and trained himself to withstand pain, punching the walls of his cell until they were covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 他自学了武术并训练自己忍受痛苦，对着牢房墙壁猛击，直到墙上沾满鲜血。

sentences.en: He plotted his murders methodically, often befriending his target over weeks or months by sharing food or belongings with them and even lowering their defences by hugging them,
sentences.zh: 他有条不紊地策划谋杀，通常通过分享食物或财物，甚至通过拥抱来降低对方的戒心，与目标建立数周或数月的友谊，

sentences.en: before striking when they least suspected.
sentences.zh: 然后在他们最不设防的时候下手。

sentences.en: Pedrínu's mother and grandmother came to visit every week.
sentences.zh: 佩德里纽的母亲和祖母每周都来探视。

sentences.en: One night, after a visit from his mother, he went to sleep early while his cellmates stayed up drinking, snorting cocaine and gambling.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，在母亲探视后，他早早睡下，而他的狱友们却熬夜喝酒、吸食可卡因和赌博。

sentences.en: Pedrínu woke up to use the toilet and noticed some of his cellmates were acting strangely, turning down the radio as he passed.

sentences.en: The next day, he caught prisoners sneaking glances at him in the yard and noticed they abruptly changed their topics of conversation when he approached.

sentences.zh: 绑在扫帚柄的两端。

sentences.en: During his workout, a guard approached and summoned Pedrínu to the prison director's office.
sentences.zh: 锻炼期间，一名狱警走过来，传唤佩德里纽去监狱长办公室。

sentences.en: The director informed him that his mother,
sentences.zh: 监狱长告诉他，他的母亲，

sentences.zh: 曼努埃拉·罗德里格斯（Manuela Rodriguez），在睡梦中被砍刀砍死。

sentences.en: Reports of the murder had been broadcast on local radio, which the inmates had heard, but no one wanted to be the one to tell him.
